title: Refactor character state toward party-oriented model
description:
The current state model is still effectively single-PC. Even if the first playable alpha is solo-focused, the object model should not make companions, sidekicks, familiars, hirelings, or future multi-PC play harder than necessary.

Coordinate with the existing multi-player-character epic instead of duplicating it.
acceptance_criteria:
- Existing multi-PC bead/epic is referenced or updated.
- Data model direction is party-oriented rather than singleton-character-oriented.
- Migration or compatibility plan exists for existing singleton character data.
- Solo play remains supported as a one-member party.
close_reason: Merged PR #87: party-oriented character model with ensureCharacterRow + inventory ownership. Verification: all CI checks pass, 582 tests pass, lint clean.
